# pai find

Search your prompt history for sessions

```
pai find QUERY [options]
```

Looks for the words in everything you typed to Claude Code and lists the sessions where they appeared.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | yes | Words to search for |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-n, --n COUNT` | number | 20 | Most sessions to show |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print a JSON array |

```sh
pai find "retry loop"
pai find login -n 5 --json
```

See also: `pai ls`, `pai open`
